headline: Türkiye Short-Term External Debt Rises to $173 Billion in September
summary: Türkiye's short-term external debt stock rose 1.5% from the previous quarter to reach $173.1 billion at the end of September, according to the central bank.
why: Short-term external debt obligations are a key indicator of external vulnerability and foreign exchange refinancing risks for emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Türkiye
impacts.why: An increase in short-term external debt raises external financing obligations.
